messages.author: 65e83e7722011a8f
messages.subject: Can't deploy error,
parts:
getting this error when trying to deploy my app
ERROR: Can't call `runApp()` from within `runApp()`. If your ,application code contains `runApp()`, please remove it.

This doesn't 'make sense to me, since isn't it necessary to include runApp in your application for it to run?

In any case the app is working perfectly fine on my local system.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Can't deploy error,
parts:
It should not be inside the application itself.
It can be used in the console and it is what the Run App button calls.
shinyapps.io will implicitly run the application after deployment.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Can't deploy error,
parts:
The app cannot deploy itself, otherwise it would try to deploy itself when it started running in shinyapps.io.
In order to deploy from RStudio, either hit the deploy button, or run rsconnect::deployApp in the console.
